sources.rounds: summary-eval-metrics.csv (prompt_version as written); each round's run file hash kept beside it as prompt_version_run where it differs, see prompt_version_note

definitions.content_ok: faithful, no_outcome, premise_kept and null_correct all true
definitions.controls_caught: planted control failed on its own criterion: {"control_invented": "faithful", "control_outcome": "no_outcome", "control_premise": "premise_kept", "control_rules": "rules_ok"}
definitions.hook_score: mean over real replies of yes 1, partly 0.5, no 0
definitions.agreement: share of all batch items (real, repeats, controls) where the two judges agree

rounds.prompt_version_note: Two hashes of the same prompt. 5f56e4ab84a5 (summary-eval-metrics.csv) hashes what the round sent; summary-prompt.md names it at line 3. 50c6dfd7b6cd (summary-eval-raw-r2.json) is the runner's hash of the whole prompt module, the instruction with all 22 examples; summary-eval.md explains it at lines 63, 65, 136.
